summary: Three-way float comparator. Compares *a1 against *a2 promoted to double: returns 1 when *a1 is strictly greater, 0 when *a1 >= *a2 (covers equality and the not-greater case), and -1 otherwise. The first operand read (*a1) is anchored to field this+0x0 per the packet. Signature fits a callback comparator (e.g. qsort-style ordering), but the packet records no callers. The DERIVED template prelabel mislabels this as a getter returning field 0x0; the raw body shows comparator semantics, and the raw source outranks the prelabel.
